title.narrative: Aufbau eines Fahrradwegnetzes im Metropolbereich Lima
Construction of a bicycle trail network in Metropolitan Lima

description.narrative: Der Transportsektor gehört in Peru zu den größten Verursachern von Treibhausgasemissionen. Lima, die Hauptstadt Perus, leidet unter extremer Luftverschmutzung und gehört zu den am stärksten belasteten Metropolen Südamerikas. Mit der Maßnahme wird der Aufbau eines Radwegenetztes im Metropolbereich Lima – als Teil eines umfassenden Mobilitätssystems – unterstützt. Dabei werden zum einen schon existierende Radwege Limas verbunden und diese zum anderen an Schnellbus- und Metrolinien angebunden. Dies schafft einen mehrfachen Nutzen: Es schützt das Klima durch Verringerung von Treibhausgasemissionen, fördert Mobilität für alle Teile der Bevölkerung zu erschwinglichen Preisen und ermöglicht so auch mehr Teilhabe der ärmeren Bevölkerungsschichten am gesellschaftlichen und wirtschaftlichen Leben.

In Peru, bicycles are hardly used as a means of public transport and even in the capital Lima there are only a few cycle lanes. So far, however, there is no sponsor at central level to support the expansion of cycling infrastructure and the local governments are overwhelmed without support for planning and financing. The aim of the project is therefore to support Peru in structuring and implementing a public investment project that establishes the bicycle as an alternative means of public transport. The bicycle network, particularly in Lima, is to be completed and intermodal connections to the metro/rapid bus system are to be established. The aim is to increase the share of non-motorised transport and raise public awareness of adapted alternative forms of transport. Planned measures include planning for the development of an integrated cycle network, financing feasibility studies for individual cycle lane sections and investment funding to complete the network in Lima. The widespread use of bicycles as a means of transport has a significant positive impact on Peru's climate goals and is in line with a reform of public transport in Peru. The project will also have a comprehensive multiplier effect. The planned FC project provides for an FC grant of EUR 20 million to the city of Lima as the project executing organisation. The DKTI project will complement the content of the following other FC projects: a) NAMA-PBL (Policy Based Lending) on urban mobility, which structures and supports policy reforms in the public transport and transport sector, b) DKTI project: Development of public transport systems in selected cities and c) Investment project for the partial financing of metro line 2 in Lima. The project is part of the German BMZ Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI) and is integrated into the BMZ priority area Sustainable Urban Development.
